lines: 📡 The next act is still waiting — armor the village (1 of 4 fighters armored); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
— DAY 90 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
On the carcass nearby, Dustboar (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.
"Your fan club is GROWING. There's fan art. It's... surprisingly good. The System is confused but supportive."
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.

📺 The Alibi Chain. Five villagers, each vouched for by the next, a chain that ends at midnight. One link is false. Break the chain before the chain breaks the village. People die in this one. Regularly. The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky. The chain, read aloud: Zuri vouches for Giulia. Giulia vouches for Owen. Owen vouches for Aria. Aria vouches
📺 You pull Zuri first — the one who vouched loudest and earliest. Zuri goes very still. "I SAW them," Zuri says, too fast. The chain rattles.

📺 Midnight is coming. The chain is under tension now — every link you've touched is stressed, and the village can see the stress. Zuri is still vouching, louder. Giulia has gone quiet. The false link is in here somewhere, holding the whole thing up.

📺 You press Zuri on the details — the hour, the lamp, the door. The vouch comes apart like wet paper. Zuri was never there. The chain was built on a loud voice and nobody checked. The village heard all of it.
📺 The false link, found: Zuri. The vouch was a kindness that became a lie that became a chain. Now: how you name it, on camera, is the whole rest of the contest.
📺 You name Zuri gently — a person who lied for someone, not against anyone. The village hears the difference. The chain breaks clean. Zuri cries. The village holds them anyway.
◈ LEVEL UP — STRANGE 1. "We've been counting: 18 brushes with the System. Pick one."
📺 The Alibi Chain — YOU WIN. The crowd is a weather system.
📈 your showbiz fans +6 — won The Alibi Chain on camera (favor: 50)
📺 The System presses something humming into your hands: Gravity well. Creates a point of intense gravity. Don't drop it.

📺 SYSTEM: "UNIT CONTRACT QUILL — the cameras kept finding it. It mattered to you on the floor, and that is... interesting. Meaning is fuel. We are curious what it becomes. (+3 bond on your Contract Quill)"
📺 The lights take their cut. Winning marks you. (-5 health.)
📺 You won. Your hands won't stop shaking for a while. (+4 trauma.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Zuri — 💧 Fetch water. Zuri nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/6/4), 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
💧 Zuri returns with 13L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Giulia telling Ingrid about Diana. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
Aria heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably."
Zuri is at the cookpot, tasting off the spoon, frowning, adding a pinch of something.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
You catch fragments by the fire — Giulia telling Ingrid about Diana. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ingrid telling Owen about Aria. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — everyone's talking about it now.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Zuri is calling it "Big Big." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
Zoltan showed Ingrid the Thorn Apple — "remember it." Word gets around.
🚶 Diana is back — found Owen.
Sanne is crouched over the embers, blowing soft, one hand blocking the draft.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 24L left.
Ingrid showed Diana the Thorn Apple — "remember it." Word gets around.
Diana sets out to find Owen. "Won't be long."
Ingrid is mending something by the door — patient work.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Spotlight: The room is already warm. Audience starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)
◈ ABILITY — Standing-O: Genuine love doesn't crater: the audience can't fall below 0 while you hold it.
◈ ABILITY — Eulogy: The quiet ones' act lands harder than any headliner. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the variety finale: ONE NIGHT ONLY

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
Aroha tells the hunt — the real one, with the fear left in. The audience goes silent in the good way. Silence, at this scale, is deafening.
The feast song — the one about eating like it matters, because it does. Trillions of beings who never ate anything hear it and feel hungry for the first time. The ratings spike is audible.

You spend it all — the love, the light, the finale slot — on people the cameras never found. You name the unfilmed villages. You name the dead. The audience weeps in eleven dimensions. This is what the show was for, it turns out.
◈ THE BELOVED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE BELOVED — "Let the audience speak."

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.

◈ OUTSHONE — Marcus Webb did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascension and all, and the village paid in full.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.

💛 You hold Contract Quill. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📋 Zuri — 🎣 Fish. Zuri nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Giulia — 🎣 Fish. Giulia nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Owen — 🍲 Cook. They'll report back by next part.
✨ Ability gained: Pocket Sand (L1). Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)
"SAND! In the eyes! It's in YOUR pocket! How?! We don't know! But it's there!"
"Earned, not given. You did the work — we just wrote it down."
